purpose: Give RedCap one executable release-readiness route before any future public npm/CLI release task changes release switches or touches external registry state.

claim_boundary.summary: This plan makes the release route auditable. It does not grant release authority by itself.

stages.title: 建立正式发布任务锚点
stages.problem: Release work must not keep borrowing migration-review or productization task state.
actions: Open a dedicated formal release task card after Norven grants release-task authorization.
Freeze baseline head, release target, package name, release level and acceptance route.
Record which manual decisions are already answered and which remain locked.
acceptance: A dedicated release task has its own task_id, report, Prism run and closeout receipt.
The task card states that prior readiness tasks cannot be reused as release completion evidence.
stop_conditions: No release target or release level has been authorized.
The task tries to reuse an unrelated closeout receipt as release evidence.
stages.human_boundary: Norven must authorize entering the formal release task; Cap can prepare the task skeleton.

stages.title: 处置剩余延期根目录组
stages.problem: Several high-risk root groups are intentionally deferred; before release they must be proved safe, moved, excluded, or explicitly deferred with evidence.
actions: Review internal-control-plane, prism-layer-and-evidence, internal-layer-a and workspace-state groups.
For each group choose one disposition: keep-at-root, package-exclude, move-in-small-tranche, or release-defer-with-proof.
Preserve archaeology aliases and rollback notes for any physical move.
acceptance: root-ia deferral check passes.
Package safety and public package surface checks prove private or volatile groups are not exposed.
Any physical move has its own task, dry-run manifest, rollback plan, Prism review and receipt.
stop_conditions: A deferred group would enter the package surface without explicit public contract.
A move risks breaking receipt anchors, aliases or clean workspace E2E.
stages.human_boundary: Cap and Prism may decide technical disposition; Norven is needed for destructive deletion or unrecoverable history loss.

stages.title: 收紧公开包面
stages.problem: A package can be technically buildable while still exposing maintainer-only tools or private/local assets.
actions: Recompute candidate files from the runtime package manifest.
Classify public runtime commands, maintainer readiness commands and packaged support files.
Trim or explicitly label any maintainer-heavy alpha surface.
acceptance: Runtime package manifest check passes with dry-run package listing.
Public package surface and runtime contract surface checks pass.
Forbidden paths and private assets are absent from the package candidate set.
stop_conditions: Any secret-like file, private archive, host-local prompt, raw evidence or identity asset appears in package candidates.
Public help or README presents maintainer checks as normal end-user workflow.
stages.human_boundary: Cap and Prism can harden package surface; Norven must approve public claims and release level.

stages.title: 验证 CLI/runtime 产品体验
stages.problem: A future user should be able to use RedCap as a tool, not as Norven's historical workspace.
actions: Verify core commands for revive, status, doctor, diagnose, debug, closeout, help and version.
Check workspace/runtime/user boundary behavior in a clean managed project.
Make error output explain the next human action instead of only naming internal gates.
acceptance: Runtime workspace boundary check passes.
CLI product surface check passes.
Clean workspace E2E passes or is explicitly rerun in the formal release task.
stop_conditions: Core CLI commands require Norven-only paths to work.
A first-time user cannot understand a common failure message.
stages.human_boundary: Cap and Prism can judge product clarity; Norven may override release-positioning language.

stages.title: 执行安全与隐私审计
stages.problem: npm package contents are visible to users, so safety must come from exclusion and scanning rather than obscurity.
actions: Run package publish safety, token risk, public package surface and secret-path checks.
Run runtime contract surface, formal release plan, release E2E matrix and clean workspace E2E checks when the formal release task requires install confidence.
Inspect dry-run package file list for local paths, credentials, identity, raw evidence and private archives.
Fail closed on any suspected secret or private asset exposure.
acceptance: Package publish safety check passes.
Token risk audit and public package surface checks pass.
No forbidden path is present in package candidates.
stop_conditions: Any credential-like content or private path is found in package candidates.
A reviewer needs to open a secret file to prove safety.
stages.human_boundary: Cap must stop on suspected leak; Norven decides only after the risk is described and fixed or explicitly rejected.

stages.title: 跑完整发布 E2E 矩阵
stages.problem: Source-tree confidence is not the same as installable-tool confidence.
actions: Run source worktree checks.
Run clean workspace local install checks.
Run dry-run package listing checks.
Either run external machine or multi-OS validation, or record an alpha-only limitation.
acceptance: Release E2E matrix check passes.
Every covered environment has current evidence.
Any deferred external environment is reflected in release claims.
stop_conditions: Clean workspace installation fails.
Dry-run package listing is inconsistent with package policy.
Stable release is requested without external environment proof.
stages.human_boundary: Norven decides whether an alpha release may proceed with explicit external-environment limitations.

stages.title: 收集人类发布决策
stages.problem: Some release choices are legal, product, account, or risk-acceptance decisions and cannot be made by AI.
actions: Ask the release authorization questionnaire.
Record license, release target, release level, version, registry scope, account readiness and risk acceptance.
Convert any allowed automation into conditional authorization, not open-ended permission.
acceptance: Release authorization matrix has Norven answers for every required decision.
No manual boundary remains unresolved before release switches are changed.
stop_conditions: License, public distribution decision, release level, registry/account readiness or version is missing.
The requested authorization would allow publishing despite failed safety gates.

stages.title: 执行最终独立评审
stages.problem: The author of release changes cannot be the only release approver.
actions: Run Prism with at least two available non-identical reviewer perspectives.
Ask reviewers to check package safety, installability, release claims, authorization coverage and rollback plan.
Bind acceptance evidence to the formal release task.
acceptance: Prism acceptance is blocker-free or every blocker has a fixed receipt.
No P0/P1 issue remains open.
stop_conditions: Prism quorum cannot be formed and no approved degraded path exists.
A reviewer finds a release blocker.
stages.human_boundary: Cap can manage Prism; Norven is needed only for risk acceptance or provider unavailability override.

stages.title: 执行真实发布动作
stages.problem: External registry mutation must only happen after all gates and human decisions are satisfied.
actions: Change release switches only if the authorization matrix permits it.
Run final preflight checks immediately before registry mutation.
Perform the registry release action and capture immutable evidence.
acceptance: Package manager confirms the published version.
A clean install from the registry succeeds.
Release receipt records package name, version, registry and git head.
stop_conditions: Any final gate fails.
Registry login or account permissions are missing.
Authorization does not explicitly allow this release level and version.
stages.human_boundary: Requires Norven's explicit or pre-recorded conditional authorization.

stages.title: 发布后监控与回滚预案
stages.problem: A release is not finished until install verification and rollback/deprecation options are known.
actions: Verify package page or registry metadata.
Run post-release smoke install.
Record known limitations, rollback/deprecate plan and next version follow-up.
acceptance: Post-release smoke test passes.
Release report and receipt are complete.
Any follow-up is registered as a new task or long-term evolution item.
stop_conditions: Published package cannot be installed.
Post-release verification reveals private data exposure.
stages.human_boundary: Norven required for deprecation, unpublish, or public incident messaging.

automation_policy.default: Cap and Prism may continue through technical checks without interruption.
must_stop_for: destructive cleanup or unrecoverable history loss
any request to mutate external package registry state without explicit authorization

next_human_step_after_this_task: Ask Norven the release authorization questionnaire only after this control-plane task closes.
